title: upp/info — Response Result
description: Server metadata including protocol version, ontology, supported operations, and conformance level.

ontology.description: The ontology identifier this server operates with (e.g., 'user/v1').

conformance_level.description: Server conformance level. 1: Minimal (ingest, retrieve, info). 2: Full (+ events, delete, labels). 3: Portable (+ export, import).
